event: Nala takes out one of the whole greymaw chambers: a fist-sized knot of polished grey bone.
She sets it on the stone in the bead's path and catches the bead with a thread of her tide.
She draws the bead to the chamber and presses it against the bone.
At her push it sinks in through the bone, as water sinks into dry sand.
She picks the chamber up and waits, cupping it in her palm. The bone stays dry.
The bone goes ice-cold in her hand, colder than snow.
A faint tug pulls at it, toward the pool. It's weak. Her fingers hold it easily.
Through the bone she can feel the bead inside: a sliver, lost in all that room.
The chamber could hold far more.
Hawise climbs down off her boulder and looks at the grey knot in Nala's palm.
Hawise: "Well. That holds it." She glances at the steaming pool. "What now, free blade?"
